newsitem.title: USA: Maine Auditor faults state's accounting practices.
newsitem.headline: Maine Auditor faults state's accounting practices.

text.p: NEW YORK, Dec 18 (Reuter) The Maine Department of Audit criticized the state's accounting practices in a report that was released on Tuesday, the first time financial operations have been reviewed under the King Administration.

The Administration defended its practices, saying progress has been made in correcting accoutning weaknesses, and noting that the audit for fiscal 1995 only covered the first six months of his tenure.
